title: Kisko pukaare haye zainab
body:
KISKO PUKAARE HAYE ZAINAB
<<DIVIDER>>
Bete kahin aur bhai kahin hai
Haye mujhpar tang zamee’n hai
Koi mera hamdard nahi hai
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye mujhe kyun maut na aayi
Lut gayi meri maa ki kamayi
Qatl huwe sab mere bhai
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalti hai Shai par tegh-e-sitamgar
Koi nahi hai monis-o-yawar
Aajao Abbas-e-Dilawar
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Dasht-e-bala hai veera’n veera’n
Jayen kahan hum log pareshaa’n
Tuhi batade sham-e-Ghareebaa’n
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Khak pa baithe sar ko jhukaye
Balo se apna chehra chhupaye
Ghabrate hain ghum ke sataye
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Aag lagi Zehra ke chaman mein
Goad ke paale sogaye run mein
Bhai bandhe hai baazu rasan mein
<<MINI>>
Kisko pukaare Haye Zainab
